versions.subject: Merge PR #5492 from @swachchhanda000 - Kerberos Coercion Via DNS SPN Spoofing
versions.detection:
selection_directory_service_changes:
    EventID:
        - 5136
        - 5137
    ObjectClass: 'dnsNode'
    ObjectDN|contains|all: # ObjectDN">DC=foo-11UWhRCAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAwbEAYBAAAA,DC=domain.com,CN=MicrosoftDNS,DC=DomainDnsZones,DC=domain,DC=com</Data>
        - 'UWhRCA'
        - 'BAAAA'
        - 'CN=MicrosoftDNS'
selection_directory_service_access:
    EventID: 4662
    AdditionalInfo|contains|all: # AdditionalInfo">DC=foo-11UWhRCAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAwbEAYBAAAA,DC=domain.com,CN=MicrosoftDNS,DC=DomainDnsZones,DC=domain,DC=com</Data>
        - 'UWhRCA'
        - 'BAAAA'
        - 'CN=MicrosoftDNS'
condition: 1 of selection_*
versions.spl: (EventID IN (5136, 5137) ObjectClass="dnsNode" ObjectDN="*UWhRCA*" ObjectDN="*BAAAA*" ObjectDN="*CN=MicrosoftDNS*") OR (EventID=4662 AdditionalInfo="*UWhRCA*" AdditionalInfo="*BAAAA*" AdditionalInfo="*CN=MicrosoftDNS*")
